summary: Import an existing PDF library into a project: single files, a folder, or a Zotero export folder (BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON). Staging batches in two lazily created tables (no migration number), paced matching to OpenAlex that pauses instead of failing, review, one-transaction commit that copies PDFs content-addressed and writes no feedback/seed, folders become categories (one undo step), optional seeds that are profile-only (not growth evidence, not map progress). Papers already in a project's library are no longer recommendation candidates. Shared PDF first-page reader extracted for project creation and import.
scope_note: Developed in git worktree .claude/worktrees/library-import (branch library-import, base 93d3ecd) because another agent is testing the current app. Not merged, not committed, not built into the primary .app.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call anywhere in the feature; harness/budget.json is unchanged. OpenAlex credits are an external quota (each search 10 credits; DOIs batched 50 per request), recorded in ADR 0029. The AI category review is reused unchanged and only started by the person from the library.
budget_impact.before: no import path; required daily model tokens 0
budget_impact.after: identical: 0 model tokens; import adds only metered OpenAlex requests (default on, disclosed, can be turned off)
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting. One independent read-only review subagent was used.

mutation checks (resolver, commit, categories, seeds, parsers, sidecar join, import-files.js)

reviews.reviewer: Read-only subagent (superpowers:code-reviewer): no P1, 10 P2 and several P3; all P2 fixed; the fixes were not independently re-reviewed

open_risks: E-LIBRARY-IMPORT is not_run: no packaged-app folder pick/drop, no real-network match rate or OpenAlex credit measurement, no real Zotero export fixture.
Import-origin seeds also stay out of learning-map progress: an extension of ROUTE-V2-06 awaiting the owner.
Old preview-server incident: main's .local/ui-redesign-data was migrated to v9 and restored from the app's own backup (verified); see the checks evidence.
No re-match of unresolved pdf: placeholders, no undo of a whole import, no budget preflight before the AI category review.
Imports enlarge the IDF corpus; the ranking effect is unmeasured.
